correctness.rationale: For every finite-colength cusp ideal of minimum valuation d, multiplication by the conductor t^2 k[[t]] proves t^{d+2}k[[t]] is included. This forces precisely the one- or two-dimensional subspace alternatives and the P1 family for every n>=2. Modulo t^2 the j_x stratification is A1 and a point at n=2,3 and all P1 at n>=4. Coefficient summation gives G exactly. The source's inspected Corollary 6.8 then gives every u>=0 formula, for arbitrary fields. Independent RREF checks over F2,F3, and the known unrefined identity corroborate; no finite experiment is used as a general proof.
